title: iOS Developer
summary: An iOS developer builds and maintains a company's iPhone app in Swift. They work in a mobile or product team with designers and back-end engineers and own the app through App Store review.
dailyDuties: Build screens in SwiftUI or UIKit
Call APIs with URLSession and Codable
Structure features with MVVM and async/await
Raise pull requests and review teammates' code
Ship builds through TestFlight and App Store review

skills.expectation: Build screens in SwiftUI or UIKit
Call APIs with URLSession and Codable
Structure an app with MVVM and async/await
Work with branches and pull requests
Ship through TestFlight and App Store review
